reviews.Author: t8989
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on July 30, 2020
reviews.Text: The Kosjer flake salt was not as much or a flake as I thought it would be. It looked bigger in the picture. Perhaps the Australian is a bigger flake. The packaging is great. Very easy to use and store. Wish they were better pictures of the white salt as it is hard to see.
reviews.Title: Not as large flakes as I thought.

reviews.Author: David Stuart
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on December 25, 2019
reviews.Text: Because of the container the flakes get broken up. They are not big flakes but a bunch of tiny bits
reviews.Title: It's ok
